summary: Social app with Internet Identity authentication, Motoko backend (user accounts, follow relationships, post storage, visit history), profile row logic showing friends/followed/last-2-visited users, glow effect when those users post, and click-to-post navigation to most recent post.
architectural_notes: Backend built with Motoko canisters on the Internet Computer
Visit history tracks last 2 visited profiles per user
No UI layout changes — only data/logic layer updates

existing_features.title: Update the StoriesRow component to populate the right-side profile bubbles using the new getProfileRowUsers() backend query. When the component mounts (and on a polling interval of ~30 seconds), fetch the profile row principals and for each user call hasNewPostSince with the last-seen timestamp stored in localStorage to determine if their avatar should glow.

When the user clicks a glowing profile bubble in StoriesRow, call getLatestPostByUser for that principal and navigate directly to that post. If the profile is not glowing, clicking it navigates to the user's profile page as before. After clicking, clear the glow state for that profile and update the last-seen timestamp in localStorage for that user.

Automatically call recordVisit(principalId) on the backend whenever the authenticated user navigates to a UserProfilePage, so the visit history is kept up to date. Do not record a visit to the user's own profile.

new_feature_requests.summary: Motoko backend with user accounts, follow relationships, post storage, and visit history tracking
Profile row populated with friends (mutual follows), followed users, and last 2 visited profiles
Glow effect on profile avatar when that user creates a new post
Clicking a glowing profile navigates directly to that user's most recent post

Extend the Motoko backend actor to store and manage visit history per user: record the last 2 unique profile principals a user has visited, expose a method to log a profile visit (recordVisit(visited: Principal)), and expose a method to retrieve the current user's visit history (getVisitHistory() : [Principal]).

Add a backend query method getProfileRowUsers() that returns the list of principals to display in the right-side profile row for the authenticated caller: mutual follows (friends), users the caller follows (non-mutual), and the last 2 visited profiles — deduplicated and ordered (friends first, then following, then visited).
Add a backend query method getLatestPostByUser(user: Principal) : ?Post that returns the single most recent post created by the specified user, or null if they have no posts.

Add a backend query method hasNewPostSince(user: Principal, since: Int) : Bool that returns true if the specified user has created at least one post after the given timestamp, enabling the frontend to determine whether a profile avatar should glow.

Generate a migration file (backend/migration.mo) to safely upgrade existing stable state with the new visitHistory stable data structure, preserving all existing posts, profiles, follows, and messages.
